scenes.text: The core rule is approval. Nothing gets scheduled until an editor who didn't write it approves it. When Maya sends her own post for review, it goes to Dana instead.

The surprise was what came after. Once a piece was in review or scheduled, nothing stopped an edit without another review. The build followed my wording and allowed it. Now the spec refuses those edits. And a daily job at eight a.m. team time can't be one UTC cron schedule.
Passing every check isn't production-ready. We never tested production sign-in, real email, the scheduled daily job, or several servers writing at once. Check those before your team relies on it.
